_about: The modern on-screen controls: Magic Rampage's inset pad, laid out for Magic Portals. The numbers of the layout, the hit
rule, the tuning grids and the art's margins, read by game/sim/Controls (planning step 180; the design is
docs/planning/2026-10-15-modern-controls.md, sections 1, 3.1 and 4.2). The CLASSIC controls are not here: they are ui.json's
hud block, untouched, and sim/Controls forwards to them.
Every number says where it came from. `_source` is an array of lines, each naming the key it is about; `_guess` is true
where the number is the port's own decision and not a measurement (a per-key `_guess_<key>` where one object holds both).
A test walks this tree and fails on a number with neither. The tags (docs/planning/2026-10-15-modern-controls.md 1.1):
DECODED = Penumbra's docs/spec/42-magic-rampage-screenpad.md (another repository, read only; its line numbers are cited as
`spec 42 l.N`), MEASURED = a tool run on a file, OWNER = the owner's decisions of 2026-10-15, PORT = a decision of this port.
Units: Magic Rampage's reference is 1280x720 and is converted BY HEIGHT: a px here is view height / reference.height_px units
(256 / 720 = 0.35556 at the port's view, 2.8125 px to a unit: ui.json _about). Nothing below is in units except where its name says so.
sim/Controls.LoadRules reads this file STRICTLY: every key below that does not begin with an underscore must be there with its
own type and range, or the file is refused and the run plays the classic controls. Unknown keys are ignored, so a later step
may add one. `layout.presets.<name>.margin_bottom_px` alone is optional (it falls back to `layout.margin_px.bottom`).
_source: clearance_px 16: DECODED spec 42 l.121: collapseButtons moves a pad button while `a.isOverlapping(b, 16 px)`. It is the adjust
screen's overlap rule (design 3.3), read by CTL-11 and kept here so the layout's numbers live in one file.
height_px 720: DECODED spec 42 l.48: the layer file's 1280x720 reference; every px below is in it, converted by height.
version 1: PORT. The number of the default arrangement (design 2.4). Whoever changes a default place bumps kLayoutVersion in
sim/Controls.hpp and this number together, so a saved move that was made against another arrangement is dropped, not misapplied.
gap_px 32: DECODED spec 42 l.78: 32 px between neighbours (the two arrows; restart and pause).
box_px 128: DECODED spec 42 l.77-78: the sprites are 128 px; the sprite box is the layout unit, flush at its edge.
corner_box_factor 0.9: the VALUE is DECODED spec 42 l.77 (the pause is 0.9 x the pad scale); the APPLICATION to restart and
clear-portals as well is PORT.
corner_min_size 1.0: PORT: a corner button never shrinks below 128 x 0.9 px = 40.96 units, whose solid face is exactly 32.0
units, the classic corner button's size, so a small arrow does not shrink restart, pause or clear.
face_inset 0.109375: MEASURED (Pillow, alpha >= 250, dpad-left/right/frame, 14 px of 128; CTL/mapC_art.md): the solid face is the
box shrunk by this fraction of the box on every side. The art's own transparent margin is art.<tier>.<id>.body_inset.
side 44, top 44, bottom 44: the VALUE is DECODED spec 42 l.78 (44 px from the screen's side edges). The APPLICATION is the
OWNER's of 2026-10-15, 'inset from the corner by the same margin': the same 44 px on both edges of every corner, the bottom
included (Magic Rampage's own bottom row is flush). The margin is to the BOX, never to the visible face (design 1.1).
The three looks (design 1.1, Q3). size is the arrow's scale on Magic Rampage's grid; margin_bottom_px is the pair's margin to the
bottom edge. Chosen FROM THE CENSUS (design 1.9): at the default the pair's top must sit below the character's row (206 units).
uniform 0.7 / 44 px: the owner's 'same margin' literally, pair top 208.50, the recommended default.
balanced 0.8 / 34 px: a larger arrow, 10 px under the margin at the bottom, pair top 207.50.
mr 1.0 / 11 px: Magic Rampage's own arrow size (spec 42 l.74-76), pair top 206.58.
size 0.7, margin_bottom_px 44: see presets.
size 0.8, margin_bottom_px 34: see presets.
size 1.0, margin_bottom_px 11: see presets.

layout._default_preset: PORT, design D1/Q3: the look the owner is shown first. One data line to change.

_source: seam_px 32: PORT (equal to layout.gap_px): a gap of at most this between two boxes is split at its middle (design 1.4 rule 2).
edge_reach_px 48: PORT (= the 44 px margin + 4 px): a side whose box edge is within this of the view's (safe-area) edge extends
to the edge, so the strip beside a box is the control's and a missed corner tap is not a portal (design 1.4 rule 3).
walk_left, walk_right, restart, pause, clear_portals: PORT, 0 each. Growth toward the world, per control. Magic Rampage grows its
touch areas 4 to 8 steps of 16 px (spec 42 l.80); 0 is right for a mouse and for a thumb on a margin (the owner's answer Q0 of
2026-10-15: desktop AND touch, growth 0 in the data; a thumb's growth is a later, MEASURED data change, and then the census of
tests/golden/controls_census.json is re-run before the list is signed). 16 px of growth costs 8, 14 or 16 levels' recorded shots
at uniform, balanced or mr (design 1.9).
act_on release: PORT, design D11 and Q8: restart, pause and clear-portals act on the RELEASE inside their hit rectangle after a
press inside it, which is the original's own Button rule (MagicPortalsLayer.cpp 8741); the classic style keeps its recorded
deviation, the press. `press` is the other value.
min 0.4, max 1.4, step 0.1: DECODED spec 42 l.75-76: the pad scale, 0.4 to 1.4 in steps of 0.1, eleven values; the tuning keeps whole
steps and divides once (design 3.1), so a chain of steps ends exactly on the limits.
min 0.2, max 1.8, step 0.2: DECODED spec 42 l.87: a multiplier, 0.2 to 1.8 in steps of 0.2, nine values.
default 1.0: DECODED spec 42 l.86 (screenPadTransparency, 1.0).
base_alpha_byte 120: DECODED + MEASURED: ui.json hud.opacity.alpha_byte, the classic controls' alpha, which the modern byte
MULTIPLIES and does not replace, so toggling the style does not change the brightness. Kept here as the number a test
compares with ui.json's.
idle_scale 1.0: PORT. Magic Rampage's own base alpha is min(0.25 / s^2, 0.25) (spec 42 l.89): 0.53 here would reproduce its ghost
look (0.25 / 0.4706). 1.0 leaves the classic byte unchanged (Q10).
boost_byte 38: PORT, a guess: a held arrow or button draws this many bytes brighter (Penumbra's pressed look is +0.15 of 255 = 38.25).
Magic Rampage's own pressed look is a flash to opaque white (spec 42 l.90, 'likely'). Read by CTL-7.
size_over_box 3.125: PORT, derived: the classic ring is 200 units over a 64-unit pad (ui.json hud.pads.ring.size_units over
hud.pads.size_units); the modern ring is that many boxes across, so it follows the arrow's size.
margin_units 8: PORT: 1-21's hint text (camera.json hint) ends this far inside the view's right edge when the pair pushes it right
(design 1.6).

_about: Which picture each control is drawn with, per tier, and the transparent margin that picture carries (design 1.3, 4.2). A tier's
file is searched for in its own place: mr = reference/magic-rampage/controls (gitignored, never committed); original = the
original's own sprite folder, through the layer's menuImage; generated = the pad art the port draws itself (sim/PadArt) into prisms.
The first tier whose picture is present is used; a tier's `body_inset` is the fraction of its picture that is transparent on each side.
